native_config_replay: All six source observation files checked byte-for-byte by SubmissionReplayTests. Native sources and output hashes also match current-submission.json.

human_review.limitation: A 50-pair sample at the recorded threshold, not model ground truth or a measurement of unlinked-record recall.
human_review.precision_basis: Conservative confirmed-correct fraction of all 50 supplied reviews; uncertain is nonconfirmed, never correct. Precision is null until all 50 decisions and reviewer names are supplied.
human_review.judgment_origin: Reviewer-supplied CSV judgments. This script generates no judgments and cannot attest that the entries were made by a human.

limitation: Offline reproduction is not fresh model inference or renewed approval. Historical synthetic approvals and the unchanged human-link audit retain their identities. New-source outcomes are indexed separately.
